bootstrap.method: paired source-cluster percentile bootstrap of clip-macro deltas
bootstrap.training_instances: fixed; average paired training-seed deltas within clip before source resampling

std.definition: sample standard deviation across training-seed clip-macro means; ddof=1

sampling.shuffled_rule: next input clip circularly; same text and noise

metric_protocol.seed_aggregation: all seeds arithmetic mean per video; no best-seed selection
metric_protocol.measurement_source: lossless float32 RGB tensors; MP4 only for playback

inference_inputs: optional supplied HRI latent and known index
sampling.hri_off: None latent/index with explicit false validity vector

metric_protocol.primary: same non-reference frames in hri_on and hri_off; provided frame excluded from both
metric_protocol.first_and_middle_reference: separate cases; never pool reference choices
metric_protocol.measurement_source: lossless float32 RGB; full videos saved; MP4 playback only
metric_protocol.ssim: existing rgb_metrics; skimage SSIM defaults, RGB data_range=1
metric_protocol.aggregation: all seeds mean per video, then equal video weights

protocol.quantization: round(clamp(rgb,0,1)*255) to uint8; every metric uses saved PNG-equivalent q/255
protocol.reference: reference-trained paired on/off with supplied GT frame0 only; no-reference-trained main all_frames plus matched_nonreference for cross-model comparisons
protocol.primary_paired_pool: no-reference-trained: all_frames primary; reference-trained on/off: identical matched_nonreference primary; all groups additionally retain both pools
protocol.temporal: official TecoGAN full sequence cutfr2/crop first, then exclude pairs touching reference; no frame joining
